'''Ceryss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] who was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and served as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] for the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was one of the commanders during the [[Korriban Incursion]], and was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Imperial forces.<ref name="Korriban" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Ceryss appears as one of the four Republic commanders that must be killed in the Imperial version of the Tactical Flashpoint "Assault on Tython," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.7: Invasion. For Republic players, Ceryss is replaced by Commander [[Vang]], and the two share many of their game mechanics.<ref name="Korriban" />
